title: Nutty Tunisian Chicken Biryani
description: A nutty and juicy Tunisian dish featuring biryani masala, perfect for a solo dinner, this recipe is egg-free friendly and easy to make.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until it is browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the biryani masala to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the basmati rice to the skillet and stir to combine with the chicken and masala mixture.
Add the chopped almonds to the skillet and stir to combine.
Season the mixture with salt to taste.
Transfer the mixture to a serving dish and serve hot.
